caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a metal balance scale or steelyard. The object consists of a long, thin, rod-like arm, colored in brown with a slightly textured appearance, extending horizontally across the image from the left to the right. Affixed near the left end of the rod is a thicker section with a rectangular, slightly angled block, also brown in color, from which a vertical metal bar descends. At the top of this vertical bar is an upward-facing hook, and at the bottom is a larger, downward-facing hook. A short vertical rod is connected near the thick end of the main arm, and a teardrop-shaped dark brown weight is suspended by a metal loop from the middle portion of the horizontal rod. The background is plain and off-white or light beige in color, with some faint staining visible. No other objects or elements are present in the drawing.
title: Steel Yard
